scope: P06 HTML/CSS/JavaScript design prototype; no Flutter, real-device or production social evidence
checks: visit → controlled compliment → sample play invitation
handmade card paper/sticker/slot/wish → recipient preview → pending → failure/retry/received
repeated submit does not duplicate gift; snapshot cloning is additionally covered by model tests
private default; selected-item filtering removes hidden images and titles from rendered DOM
invite preview invalidation; incoming accept/decline; no friendship before explicit resolution
blocked mail cancellation; no automatic recipient change; report remains available after block
private and moderation-held work hidden on home/profile/detail, not merely covered by CSS

native Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter/Space/Escape and focus return, including live system locale changes

reload loses social/draft state but retains language only
reduced motion: system and local; no animations
all visible buttons/selects >=48 CSS px; no measured page/text overflow
no JS/HTTP errors, external requests or non-GET requests
